selection.areaFocusQuery: areas=comma-separated stable neighborhood IDs (≤ 3) or areas=all to disable auto focus
selection.provinceQuery: province=<production code BKK|PKT|CMI|SPK|NBI|CBI|PTE|UDN|NMA>; legacy Thai/English names still resolve
selection.cameraQuery: view3d=0 forces the plan preset; cam=model switches the venue-level camera from eye (default) to model; legacy cam=eye is accepted
selection.panelQuery: store=<row id> opens store mode; place=<center id> opens venue mode; neighborhood=<area id> opens neighborhood mode
selection.legacyMallQuery: mall=<center id> narrows the venue filter to that center's label when present

developerWorkflow: Read AGENTS.md, then handoff/README.md, PRODUCT_STATEMENT.md and the paired human/machine briefs
Run npm test before changes; keep the three row scopes, the focus modes and the panel action contract
Change one bounded task at a time; preserve invariant IDs INV01–INV25
Validate calculations with real dataset fixtures in tests/; tile-dependent code uses tests/fixtures/mvt-sample.pbf
Review rendered Thai/English at 390 px and desktop in both themes; use the stub-tile harness when CDN/tiles are blocked, then confirm the real-tile look live
Tune camera and massing live via window.__citymeter in the console before changing constants
Publish only authorized changes; wait for the Pages run; run verify:live before reporting a release
Regenerate the manifest and bundle from final bytes; never hand-edit hashes
3D layer order is a contract: host extrusion first, massing tiers inserted before it, venue-xray last — check with map.getStyle().layers / map.getLayer after any spatial change
